quotes.text: Safeguarding means that we have to keep all of your money in accounts that are completely separate from the ones we use to run our business.

Not only are your funds held in dedicated safeguarding accounts which Remitix Limited holds with banks in the UK, but we also use rigorous internal safeguarding measures and procedures designed to ensure that our customers, other counterparties, and the wider market are protected in the event of financial stress.

Remitix must safeguard relevant customer funds relating to remittance services by holding them separately from its own money in designated safeguarding accounts with authorised and reputable credit institutions or approved banks.
